# Contributor permission forms

Short forms a contributor signs to say what Pillar-43 may do with their work.
Print one per person. Staff record the signed form by following
[../guides/permissions.md](../guides/permissions.md).

| Form | Who signs |
|---|---|
| [permission-form-writer.md](permission-form-writer.md) | an author, poet or anthologist |
| [permission-form-translator.md](permission-form-translator.md) | a translator, for their own drafts and letters |
| [permission-form-estate.md](permission-form-estate.md) | the executor or other representative of a deceased writer |

The three levels and five terms are the ones in `api/orgs/press.yaml`. Another
press changes the wording here to match its own `org.yaml`.

Legal review of the wording: **[the maintainer / press counsel]**.
